texts.text:
ORDINANCE



        BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:



SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all the RS-2 and RS-3 Single Unit (Detached House) Districts and B1-1
Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and identification as shown on Maps No. 24-E and 24-F in the
area bounded by:

        West 95th Street; South State Street; south right-of-way line of the Bishop Ford Expressway; South
        Wentworth Avenue; West 99th Street and extended where no street exists; east right-of-way line
        of Union Pacific Railroad; West 98th Place and South Lafayette Avenue; West 96th Street; the
        alley next east of and parallel to South Perry Avenue; a line 306.23 feet north of and parallel to
        West 96th Street; South Layfette Avenue (RLE Rezoning Section 1)

to those of a T, Transportation District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.

Common Addresses of Property: 9528 through 9558 S. Lafayette Ave; Dan Ryan Expressway from 95th
Street to the east right-of-way line of the Union Pacific Railroad.




___________________________ _________________________                     _____________________

Anthony A. Beale                       Peter Chico                          Ronnie L. Mosley
